rows.grounds: compound gūḍha plus sadbhāva in accusative singular masculine
middle present third singular of jan with prefix pra

items.question: What arises upon knowing the hidden true nature?
premises: Knowing hidden true nature causes all-knowingness.
items.inference: Knowledge of the hidden true nature produces all-knowingness.
uncertainties: The exact referent of taṃ depends on prior context.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
